name: Kiri
source:
A young woman by the name of Kiri is forced to visit her aunt where she discovers a mysterious book. The book sends her to a land where all books are rare and sacred and she is in great trouble for possessing her own.

[From [url=https://otakuworld.com/shibai/index.html?/shibai/pages/kiri.html]Otaku World[/url]]
